note.windows: The first build takes 15 to 30 minutes and about 2 GB. Python, LLVM, CMake, Ninja and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once. Works with GOG's release (installed, or its offline installer) and the 1994 CD.
note.default: The first build takes 10 to 20 minutes and about 2 GB. It needs gcc, CMake, Python 3, git, SDL2 and ALSA's development files (and innoextract for GOG's installer) from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them. Works with GOG's release and the 1994 CD.
note.darwin: The first build takes 10 to 20 minutes and about 2 GB. It needs Xcode's command line tools (xcode-select --install) and Homebrew (brew.sh); CMake, pkg-config, SDL2, Python and innoextract are installed with brew if missing. Music plays on Apple's built-in synth. Works with GOG's release and the 1994 CD.

choices.note: In Docker (needs Docker running): about 3.5 GB of toolchain the first time. Play it in Chrome from this computer.
